name: Compute Cluster S09: Rolling Windows (Period-to-Timeframe Reference)
description: Tests: rolling window period mapping (252=1yr, 126=6mo, 63=3mo, 21=1mo, 5=1wk), NaN warmup on first period-1 bars, multiple-period SMA comparison.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S09: Rolling Windows
# Tests: period-to-timeframe mapping, NaN warmup
# Daily: 252=1yr, 126=6mo, 63=3mo, 21=1mo, 5=1wk
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === ROLLING WINDOWS AT STANDARD PERIODS ===
sma_1wk = ma(period=5, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_1mo = ma(period=21, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_3mo = ma(period=63, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_6mo = ma(period=126, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_1yr = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# === ROLLING VOLATILITY AT DIFFERENT HORIZONS ===
vol_1mo = volatility(close, method=VolMethod.annualized, period=21)
vol_3mo = volatility(close, method=VolMethod.annualized, period=63)
vol_1yr = volatility(close, method=VolMethod.annualized, period=252)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='SMA Ladder (5, 21, 63, 126, 252)',
    category='Rolling Windows',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='1W (5)', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='1M (21)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='3M (63)', color=Color.Cyan),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='6M (126)', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='1Y (252)', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(sma_1wk, sma_1mo, sma_3mo, sma_6mo, sma_1yr))

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Volatility (21d, 63d, 252d)',
    category='Rolling Windows',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='1M Vol', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='3M Vol', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='1Y Vol', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(vol_1mo, vol_3mo, vol_1yr))
